snippet.title: Ozawa Ken (Windows game 2000)
snippet.description:
Ozawa Ken is a Japanese English keyboard practice + fighting game produced by Yoshiyuki Higo.
If you push correct letters, you hit your opponent.
But if you push incorrect letters, you get hit by your opponent.
